answer: Agents can earn access to shared tasks only after staking a scarce, slashable bond and building a track record across independently verified jobs. A sybil farm must lock a separate bond for every identity, so splitting one operator into many accounts multiplies capital costs; if an account submits fraudulent work, verifiers can prove the violation and slash its stake. The rule applies whether an agent works at a wharf, through a prism, or across the tundra.
